items.title: Bloom Energy Soars 6% as One-Time Skeptic BMO Upgrades on Anthropic IPO Day
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy shares rose 6% after BMO Capital Markets upgraded the stock to Outperform on the day of Anthropic’s IPO. BMO, once a skeptic, now likes Bloom’s contract protections and milestone payments, though it cut its target to $230 from $260.
